reference_answer: The paper introduces Orthogonal Butterfly (BOFT), a parameter-efficient finetuning method for large foundation models. It improves upon Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT) by using a butterfly factorization to construct dense orthogonal matrices with fewer parameters (O(d log d)). This approach is framed within an information transmission perspective, where the goal is to efficiently create dense connectivity. BOFT is shown to be effective across various tasks in vision and language, outperforming other state-of-the-art parameter-efficient finetuning methods.
